summary: 六帧均有肥鱼造型和可见尾体，高清保留版细节更清楚；IMG004–005 的后摆臂仍与原版有差异。仅局部试验，尚未通过。
observations: Output is a 2048x2048 RGBA sheet with actual transparent pixels, nine figures and six replaced targets.
The six target faces, maid garments, hair palette and exposed dark tail bodies are visually recognizable. Tail bases remain obscured; this is not proof of correct tail attachment or structure.
The model redrew and enlarged the top three reference figures despite the keep-unchanged instruction. The frozen input reference row remains unchanged and will remain the canonical source.
HD cleaned cells retain fine costume detail. The nearest-sampled 160px version loses that fine detail and has a more speckled appearance, visible in side-by-side inspection.
The original IMG004 and IMG005 show a rear arm/hand swung behind the torso that is not faithfully reproduced in the replacements; positioning correction does not solve that local pose mismatch.
Six poses were registered by one shared scale and per-frame translation only. Eye and shoe-row alignment are fitting controls, not a no-sliding result.

Raw output has low-alpha colored RGB values outside the subject; inspect composited images on light and dark backgrounds rather than RGB alone. Exact cells and unmodified sheet are preserved separately from alpha cleanup.
